Server Scout — find Discord communities by country

Active servers in the German-speaking world, Canada, France, Spain, Italy, Poland and the Netherlands. Every entry is a real, live listing with a direct link to its Discord page.

How the links work

Discord invites expire and change often. Instead of guessing invite URLs, every Join button here opens that server's official Discord page — where the current working invite is right on the page. One click, then you're in.

  • Member counts are the servers' own figures and may drift by up to a week.
  • Online counts are approximate, current within about six hours.
  • Check a server's rules and age requirements before posting.
Not affiliated with Discord Inc. Server names and descriptions belong to their respective owners.
